title: How the Eureka trumpets work and rehearsals
summary: Three trumpets rotate so one keeps the lead; the band holds no regular rehearsals and reads new marches on the street.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

They have three trumpets, and all of them have a job. All of us have a job, they do. And the way we operate, uh, we start off three trumpets, and we play the chorus down, and, uh, well, we'll leave, say, two trumpets, the second chorus, you see.
